title: Offboard a business
intro: A business is offboarded only once its management has confirmed an export produced after the last change. Then every user is deactivated, the data stays ten years in the archive and is then deleted.

forbidden.title: Nexotec staff only
forbidden.body: This page is for the Nexotec team, signed in with a second factor.

done: The business is offboarded. Every user is deactivated.
offboardError: The business could not be offboarded.

refusal.export_not_acknowledged: The management has not confirmed an export yet. It requests one under Administration › Data export and confirms the receipt.
refusal.export_out_of_date: Data changed after the confirmed export. The management produces a new export and confirms it.

archive.title: Archive export
archive.intro: After offboarding there is no sign-in. When the former management asks for a copy, produce an export from the archive here – with a reason, audited.
archive.reasonPlaceholder: Who asked for the copy, and when?
archive.requested: The archive export is being produced.
archive.error: The archive export could not be requested.

confirm.title: Offboard the business?
confirm.body: {{name}} will be offboarded: every user is deactivated, nobody can sign in any more, and the data goes into the archive for ten years. This cannot be undone.

refusals.dealership_not_offboarded: An archive export is for an offboarded business only; an active business exports its own data.
refusals.archive_erased: This business's archive was deleted after its retention period.
refusals.export_not_acknowledged: The management has not confirmed an export yet.
refusals.export_out_of_date: Data changed after the confirmed export – the management exports and confirms again.
refusals.user_last_manager_of_sister: A user of this business is the last manager of another business. Give that business another manager first.
